chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then Itto — Superlative Superstrength, both targeting Fuzzy Wurm Crawler. This dealt 23 damage, left it at 1 HP, and gained 6 Block against its 4-damage attack.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Itto — Superlative Superstrength plus Water's Edge, which would also provide 6 Block but deal only 20 damage and leave the enemy at 4 HP.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up playing multiple 1-cost Hydro attacks; using all three would deal 21 damage but gain no Block. It also spent all energy without killing the enemy.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. With only the printed effects available, this line gives the highest damage while also gaining Block, so a different telegraphed intent would not have changed my play.
